mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC over 5 years remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) below 1050.0 and retail sales (RSAFS) below 440,000 indicate contracting consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST < 1050.0 and RSAFS < 440,000 fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases over 5 years, or interaction Rank IC remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 indicates weakening manufacturing output, reducing corporate investment and earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns during economic slowdowns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 105.0, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) above 1050.0 signals strong consumer confidence and residential investment, boosting corporate revenues and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1050.0, or Rank IC over 2 years remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 3.5% annually signals accelerating inflation that forces the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strong job growth (PAYEMS above 200k) and low unemployment (UNRATE below 4.0%) indicate a tight labor market that fuels wage inflation and corporate cost pressures, reducing profit margins and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE < 4.0% fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases over 5 years, or interaction Rank IC remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%), the Federal Reserve faces policy constraints that erode confidence in monetary management, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.
